reason: Long-only trend following on US stocks using new highs on daily/weekly bars with price-based exits and fixed risk sizing.

setup.rule: Buy stocks in uptrends using new highs screens
setup.quote: I buy stocks in uptrends and manage risk.

setup.rule: New highs on daily or weekly: all-time highs, 52-week highs or 50-day highs
setup.quote: simple stuff, they're really simple screens, all time highs, 52 week highs, they could be 50 day highs, they just need to be new highs and whatever timeframe best suits you

entry.rule: Take signal on new high; act immediately on signal
entry.quote: when you get your signal, just take it, just instantly acting on it

stop.rule: Exit when trend invalidated by price

exits.rule: Exit on trend invalidation by price alone
exits.quote: if the trend invalidates by price alone, then I'm out

ambiguities.issue: Exact exit rule (e.g. 25-day low) and consolidation filter not stated for stocks
ambiguities.assumption: Similar to futures example of new 50-day high entry / 25-day low exit
